note: Contents of the loot lists named by _Template_Events.Loot. The retail server owned these lists and the client data only names them, so they are authored here. While an event runs, every kill of a monster whose _Template_Monster.EventDropChance is above zero rolls its event's list on maps the event does not exclude. Per rank class (monster; elite = guardian, champion, leader; boss = boss, worldboss) an entry gives a chance, scaled by EventDropChance, and an amount range [min, max]; a missing class uses monster's values. An entry with regions instead drops from every monster on maps of those regions (or monsters of them), unscaled: the event maps' own loot. An item containing {difficulty:02d} drops the map difficulty's variant.
